finding: Replay hours are strongly temporally autocorrelated; the 9,135 window hours are not 9,135 independent cases.
evidence: Hourly series over 1,827 consecutive days; the 11 RESOLUTION wave nulls are a single contiguous 11-hour block, which is itself evidence of block structure.
impact: No naive IID confidence interval or significance test may be applied to state occupancy. All figures here are exact retrospective frequencies over an archived period, not estimates with sampling error.
